title: 1000X
tagline: A trading bots suite for creating and managing trading bots using NEAR and 1inch Protocol
description:
Crypto stocks may be going high, we may be anticipating to make a trade but that plan just goes away because we can't make it in minutes... We have all been in this situation

1000X solves the problem!

Generate contracts for trading bots, deploy them in minutes, make AI-powered analysis of market and make your trade in a few clicks!

With the power of Shade agents, 1000X creates secure quotes and verify them seemlessly.

With the power of 1inch Fusion, data across chains and cross-chain swaps are no longer dreams.
how_its_made:
The project uses NEAR protocol for generating quotes from intent and sign them securely with the help of a verifier. 1inch Fusion is used to fetch crypto data to make analysis on them, it is also used for cross-chain swaps while trading.

Workflow:
User connects the wallet -> Selects whether to trade or generate a bot contract

1. Trading
User is listed with the best trade that can be done based on the metadata of bots (from NEAR contract) and 1inch crypto data.
User proceeds with trading and the result is shown.

2. Generate a bot:
User types his requirements in a form on what kind of bot he is in need of. The intent is passed to shade agents and the quote containing the contract is returned. User approves (signs) if he finds that the bot suits his needs or gives new prompts to improve it.

User can also manage his bots. This is done using the NEAR protocol that stores the metadata of bots of each user.

Finally, user can manage his portfolio, analyze it and and get summaries.
